verdict.rationale: Dagster documents CLI-based scaffolding (create-dagster, dg scaffold defs), Python API-based asset/job definitions, and a dedicated AI-agent skill (dagster-expert) plus an MCP server for AI sessions, all supporting headless setup and execution (dg dev, dg CLI). However, there's no single documented end-to-end example of an agent scaffolding+configuring+running a full pipeline purely headlessly without the webserver/UI in the loop, and no independent/hands-on verification of an agent doing this autonomously. missing for 10: a concrete end-to-end headless run example with no UI dependency, independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent successfully completing the full scaffold-to-run loop via CLI/API alone.
